- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:3047-3053 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The RB_HEAD_SHA override to RB_LIVE_HEAD_SHA fires whenever the live head differs from the judged head. It does not re-verify the guard's exemption shape, and it departs from the literal "use RB_JUDGED_HEAD_SHA" instruction.
  WHY: It is correct today, but a future widening of the stale-head exemption would silently apply the live-head substitution to unauthorized cases.
